## Details

- Date: Tuesday, 1 December 2026
- Time: 09:00–15:45 CET
- Location: Room 331, Main Building, University of Bern, Hochschulstrasse 4, 3012 Bern, Switzerland
- Cost: Free of charge
- Access: Not open to the public
- Registration: [Registration form](https://www.ub.unibe.ch/services/open_science/os_events/event_forms/unibe_research_data_day_registration_formular_2026/index_eng.html)
- Event page: [UniBE Research Data Day 2026](https://www.ub.unibe.ch/services/open_science/os_events/event_forms/unibe_research_data_day_2026/index_eng.html)

## About

The Open Science Team at the University of Bern is organising UniBE Research Data Day 2026 around the question of how to make research data useful beyond publication.

The event combines a short lecture on the prerequisites for useful data with practical workshops presenting specific strategies and tools. It focuses on helping researchers consider how others can use the data they share.
